goal: Refocus llm-wiki-ontology-ingest into a thin DuckGraph-lite operator that detects repo capabilities, proposes the right single or batch workflow, relies on repo-owned runtime gates, performs bounded repair, and turns repeated failures into review-only improvement proposals.

userStories.title: Refocus ingest skill as a capability-aware operator
userStories.description: As a wiki operator, I want the ingest skill to inspect the workspace and select the available ingest lane instead of repeating bootstrap AGENTS.md or assuming one legacy runner exists.
acceptanceCriteria: SKILL.md clearly assigns repo contracts/runtime to bootstrap, orchestration to this skill, and ontology truth conventions to lightweight-ontology-core.
The workflow distinguishes llm-first-ontology, wiki-plus-ontology, and wiki-only capabilities without relying on semantic filename or keyword routing.
The skill no longer unconditionally recommends scripts/llm_full_ingest.py and instead selects only commands that exist in the target repo.
Existing closed-pipeline and semantic no-fallback guarantees remain explicit.

userStories.title: Bind ingest completion to existing procedure and batch gates
userStories.description: As a wiki operator, I want every ingest plan to start and finish through the repo-owned run or batch gate with bounded repair and an honest completion posture.
acceptanceCriteria: Single-source flow uses wiki_workflow.py and fresh final review; large-source flow uses wiki_batch.py, one writer, pipeline_check.py --strict, representative questions, and corpus certification when available.
The skill reuses state/wiki_runs and state/wiki_batches rather than creating a duplicate plan/event runtime.
A bounded same-run repair loop maps structured blockers to targeted repair and never labels stale or unavailable semantic judgment complete.
Completion reporting distinguishes ready, partial, not_ready, and blocked outcomes.

userStories.title: Add proposal-only repeated-failure improvement loop
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want recurring stable ingest failures to produce a reviewable improvement proposal without allowing the skill to rewrite runtime contracts or canonical truth automatically.
acceptanceCriteria: The skill applies local repair to an isolated failure and requires at least three independent runs with the same stable failure and contract digest before proposing a reusable improvement.
Improvement proposals contain bounded metadata and expected tests, exclude raw/private source content, and require human review before adoption.
Automatic canary deployment, rollback machinery, daemon scheduling, runtime self-modification, and automatic truth promotion are explicitly out of scope.
Repo-local and global llm-wiki-ontology-ingest skill copies are synchronized.
Skill validation and the relevant repository test suite pass, and the worktree contains only the pre-existing user-owned untracked paths.
